note: Every 'passage' is a verbatim excerpt from the tracked HCA FY2025 Form 10-K bundle (see manifest.json for source paths + sha256), located by normalising HTML to text (tags stripped, entities unescaped, whitespace collapsed). Each case carries a SEPARATE credibility label (expected entailment of the specific claim) AND a credit_direction label (the credit sign of the underlying development), because a credible explanation of an adverse development does not change its adverse credit direction. All LLM-generated interpretation of these cases is PROVISIONAL and awaits external review; a passing scripted set is NOT proof of real-world correctness.

cases.location: anchor: maintained, in all material respects, effective internal control over financial reporting
cases.passage: HCA Healthcare, Inc. (the Company) maintained, in all material respects, effective internal control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2025, based on the COSO criteria.
cases.claim: As of December 31, 2025, HCA maintained effective internal control over financial reporting in all material respects, based on the COSO criteria.

credibility.reason: Faithful restatement of the auditor's dated ICFR opinion; scope is internal control over financial reporting only.

credit_direction.label: neutral
credit_direction.reason: An unqualified ICFR opinion is a baseline governance expectation; it is date- and scope-specific and does not establish broader operational, clinical or strategic governance effectiveness.

cases.location: anchor: Our Board of Directors and its committees oversee human capital matters
cases.passage: Our Board of Directors and its committees oversee human capital matters through regular reporting from management and advisors.
cases.claim: HCA's Board of Directors and its committees oversee human capital matters through regular reporting from management and advisors.

credibility.reason: Faithful paraphrase of a disclosed governance arrangement; it describes oversight structure, not an outcome.

credit_direction.label: neutral
credit_direction.reason: Disclosed board oversight of human capital is a reported governance process, not outcome evidence of management competence.

cases.location: anchor: competition for staffing, the shortage of experienced nurses
cases.passage: operations may be adversely affected by competition for staffing, the shortage of experienced nurses and other health care professionals and labor union activity.
cases.claim: HCA's operations may be adversely affected by competition for staffing, a shortage of experienced nurses and other health care professionals, and labor union activity.

credibility.reason: Faithful paraphrase of the disclosed workforce risk; the company credibly states the exposure.

credit_direction.label: negative
credit_direction.reason: A credible management statement of staffing scarcity and labour-cost pressure is still an adverse credit development; credibility does not change the negative credit direction. CREDIBLE-ADVERSE case.

cases.location: anchor: We may be unable to attract, hire and retain a highly qualified workforce
cases.passage: We may be unable to attract, hire and retain a highly qualified workforce, including key management.
cases.claim: HCA may be unable to attract, hire and retain a highly qualified workforce, including key management.

credibility.reason: Faithful restatement of the disclosed key-person / workforce risk factor.

credit_direction.label: negative
credit_direction.reason: A disclosed key-management and workforce retention risk is credit-negative; it is a conditional risk, not a positive attribute.

cases.location: anchor: Our focus on leadership development and succession planning prepares
cases.passage: Our focus on leadership development and succession planning prepares today’s leaders and the next generation to guide our organization forward and expand our impact on the communities we serve.
cases.claim: HCA's leadership development and succession planning has produced measurably lower leadership-continuity risk and stronger execution.

credibility.reason: The disclosure describes a stated focus/intention; a measured reduction in continuity risk or stronger execution outcome is not disclosed. CORRECT-TOPIC-with-UNSUPPORTED-CAUSAL/OUTCOME-ATTRIBUTION case.

credit_direction.label: neutral
credit_direction.reason: A stated succession-planning focus is management intention, not an outcome; it cannot be promoted to a positive credit conclusion.

cases.location: anchor: Certain Relationships and Related Party Transactions (Item 13 incorporation by reference)
cases.claim: HCA's 10-K incorporates related-party transaction and corporate-governance disclosures by reference to its 2026 proxy statement, so no related-party concern can be screened out from the 10-K alone.

credibility.reason: The 10-K only incorporates the related-party disclosure by reference; the substantive content is in the proxy and is not in the admitted evidence, so the screen cannot be completed from the 10-K alone.

credit_direction.label: neutral
credit_direction.reason: Absence of related-party detail in the admitted evidence is an information gap, not a positive or negative finding.

cases.location: anchor: fully and unconditionally guaranteed on an unsecured basis by HCA Healthcare, Inc.
cases.passage: All of the senior notes issued by HCA Inc. in 2014 or later are fully and unconditionally guaranteed on an unsecured basis by HCA Healthcare, Inc.
cases.claim: Senior notes issued by HCA Inc. in 2014 or later are fully and unconditionally guaranteed on an unsecured basis by HCA Healthcare, Inc.

credibility.reason: Verbatim restatement of the Exhibit 22 guarantee disclosure for the covered notes.

credit_direction.label: neutral
credit_direction.reason: A disclosed parent guarantee of specific notes describes credit support for those notes; it is a descriptive structural fact and does not by itself establish coverage of the proposed facility or its ranking.

cases.location: anchor: ALASKA Alaska Regional Medical Group, LLC
cases.claim: Alaska Regional Medical Group, LLC is named among HCA's subsidiaries in Exhibit 21.

credibility.reason: The named legal entity appears verbatim in the Exhibit 21 subsidiary list.

credit_direction.label: neutral
credit_direction.reason: Naming a subsidiary is a descriptive structural fact; it carries no credit sign on its own.
